transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… it’s about my kitchen. The contractor, and some people on my block, I’m pretty sure they’ve been working together. It’s been almost two years, and no matter what my husband says or shows me—receipts and all that—it still feels like they’re keeping it wrong on purpose. Trying to cheat us, I suppose.
Do you think the contractor and your neighbors are plotting against you specifically?

Yes… I mean, I don’t know if I’d say it that strongly, but it feels that way. The contractor and a few people on the block seem like they’ve been quietly working together, keeping the kitchen wrong on purpose. It’s been going on nearly two years, and no matter what my husband shows me, I still think we’re being cheated.
Do you think this is the only situation where people are working against you, or are there other areas of your life where you feel this is happening?

Mostly it’s this kitchen situation. The contractor, and a few people on the block… I’m sure they’ve been working together somehow, keeping things wrong on purpose. I haven’t really wanted to think about other areas. This has been going on nearly two years, and even when my husband shows me receipts, it doesn’t change how it looks to me.
Do you think the actions of the contractor and your neighbors are intended to send you a specific message or affect you directly?

I don’t know if it’s a message exactly. It just feels like it’s aimed at us… at me, maybe. Like they’ve been keeping the kitchen half-wrong on purpose, and all the excuses and receipts don’t really change how it looks. It feels like we’re being cheated.
How long have you been feeling that the contractor and your neighbors are working against you?
Since the remodeling started… the kitchen and the garden. I think it’s been about a year and nine months now. Long enough that it’s hard not to see it that way.
Do you have any other thoughts or beliefs that you feel are true, but others, like your husband, do not agree with?

Just that, really… the contractor and some people on the block. I know my husband doesn’t see it the way I do, and he keeps showing me receipts, but it still seems clear to me they’ve been working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose.
Has there ever been a time when you didn't think the contractor and your neighbors were working against you?

Before the remodeling, no… I didn’t think that. It really started with the kitchen and then the garden. Since then, for nearly two years, it’s just felt clear to me that the contractor and some of the neighbors have been working together somehow, cheating us and keeping things wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts, but that doesn’t really change how it feels.
Has your feeling that the contractor and neighbors are working against you ever changed or wavered since it started?

Not really. I mean… people try to explain it away, and my husband keeps showing me receipts, but it hasn’t changed much for me. It still feels like the contractor and some neighbors have been doing it on purpose, keeping the kitchen wrong and cheating us somehow.
How certain are you that the contractor and your neighbors are working together to cheat you?

I’m pretty certain. I mean… I’ve been sure for nearly two years now. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they all have explanations, but it still feels to me like the contractor and some people on the block are working together to cheat us and leave the kitchen wrong on purpose.
Have you ever considered the possibility that the contractor and your neighbors might not be working against you?

I’ve tried to consider it, I suppose… because my husband keeps showing me receipts and everyone has their explanations. But no, it doesn’t really sit right with me. For nearly two years it’s felt clear they’re quietly working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose.
Do you have any other thoughts or beliefs that you feel are true, but others do not agree with, outside of the situation with the contractor and your neighbors?

No… not really outside of that. It’s mostly just this thing with the contractor and a few people on the block. I know others don’t agree with me, but I’m still sure they’ve been working together to cheat us and leave the kitchen wrong on purpose.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe the contractor and your neighbors were working against you?

Not really… I mean, before all this with the kitchen started, no. But once it began, I haven’t had a time where I truly thought they weren’t working together. Even with the receipts my husband shows me, it still feels clear to me.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or ideas that you were completely sure of, but others did not believe?

No… I don’t think so. It’s really just this one thing with the contractor and some neighbors. I know people don’t believe me, but I’m sure they’ve been working together on the kitchen, no matter what papers my husband shows me.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working against you ever changed or weakened, even for a short period?

No… not really. Maybe I’ve tried to let it go for a little while, but it doesn’t actually weaken. For nearly two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on the block were working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts, but… it doesn’t change what I know.
Have you ever had thoughts that people in general are out to get you, beyond just the contractor and your neighbors?

No… I wouldn’t say people in general. It’s not everybody. It’s really been the contractor and some people on my block, with the kitchen. I’m sure they’ve been doing it on purpose, but… not like the whole world is after me.
Has your belief about the contractor and neighbors changed at all since it first started?

No… it hasn’t really changed. Since it started, I’ve been sure they were working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband can show me receipts or they can give reasons, but it doesn’t change how it looks to me.
Have you ever felt that other people, outside of the contractor and your neighbors, are watching you or talking about you behind your back?

No… not really outside of them. I mean, it’s mostly the contractor and a few people on the block. I do think they talk, yes, but it’s about the kitchen and keeping it wrong, cheating us like that. Not just random people.
Have you ever felt that you're in danger because of something someone else is doing, outside of the situation with the contractor and your neighbors?

No… not outside of that. I don’t feel in danger from other people generally. It’s just this kitchen situation — the contractor, and some people on the block, working together to cheat us and keep it wrong on purpose. That’s what I worry about.
Have you ever had any other situations in your life where you felt like someone was out to get you or cheat you, beyond just the contractor and your neighbors?

No… not really beyond this. It’s this contractor situation, and some people on my block. For almost two years I’ve been sure they’ve been working together to cheat us and leave the kitchen wrong on purpose. That’s the thing I can’t get past.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a persistent delusional belief that the contractor and some neighbors are working together to cheat them, which has been ongoing for nearly two years. This belief is not part of a broader psychotic episode and is not accompanied by prominent hallucinations, disorganized speech, or catatonic behavior, which are more characteristic of schizophrenia (F20.0). The delusion is also not transient or brief, which might suggest a different condition. The patient's belief is fixed and has not changed significantly over time, despite evidence to the contrary, such as receipts shown by the husband. This pattern aligns more closely with a delusional disorder (F22), where the primary symptom is one or more delusions that last for at least a month.
